verdict_text:
YES

The merge logic matches the specification: scale is read as lora_alpha / r (2), delta is B @ A computed in float32 (adapter tensors are float32), added to the upcast base weight and cast back to float16, with no transpose since fan_in_fan_out is false; adapter tensors are never inserted into the state dict, and all four required checks are asserted before writing. The only caveat is that sharding and index generation are delegated to the unseen helper `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, so the 512 MiB limit, lone-tensor shards, and the `model.safetensors.index.json` weight_map cannot be confirmed from this file alone.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
